name: Decapolis
overview: The Decapolis refers to a group of ten cities located east of the Sea of Galilee, as noted in the Gospels. These cities are significant in the ministry of Jesus, with large crowds coming from Decapolis to follow Him (Matthew 4:25) and the region serving as a backdrop for Jesus' miracles and teachings (Mark 5:20; 7:31). The Scriptures highlight how Jesus’ works impacted this Gentile region, demonstrating His power and the spread of His message beyond traditional Jewish areas.
